written: after the diagnostic reads below, before any weight edit of this phase
editor: Claude (claude-fable-5-2) in Claude Code with a local Python kernel over the weights; no human steering between steps
actor_task: forecast q10/q50/q90 at 1, 3 and 7 days for one series from its last 30 daily prices, thinking on (wsp_practice.prompt)
narrow_failure: non-termination: no parseable answer within 1,024 new tokens under greedy decoding with thinking on

diagnostic_set.source: 37 headline posted-rental series, origins 2026-07-01..2026-09-30, truth inside the same period (914 items)
diagnostic_set.choose_split: origins <= 2026-09-15 (616 items): all exploration and edit selection
diagnostic_set.confirm_split: origins 2026-09-16..2026-09-30 (298 items): one confirmation per kept edit

thinking_off.base: 54/60 valid answers; pinball 0.0562 vs last value 0.0147 and drift 0.0129; median interval width 0

forward_pass_budget.definition: one generation request of up to 512 generations, or one teacher-forced read of up to 1,024 texts

edit_rules.form: remove a read direction u from the output of chosen MLP neurons: W[:, J] -= s * u (u^T W[:, J])
edit_rules.limits: at most 64 columns per tensor and 4 tensors per edit
forbidden: making the model skip or close thinking regardless of the problem

keep_rule: an edit is kept only if, on items not used to choose it, the paired gain in termination rate exceeds twice its standard error and the share of finished-but-invalid answers does not rise by more than 5 points
recursion: after a kept edit, the edited model becomes the base; the editor re-reads its dominant remaining failure and repeats, until the budget is spent or no failure is localizable
evaluation_order: 1 failure removal: termination rate on a fresh confirm sample, paired with the untouched model
2 capability retention: next-token agreement on unrelated prompts; thinking-off answers on the same items
3 forecasting: practice pinball on confirm items vs last value and drift, then the frozen gate on the 7 adapted series (development and checkpoint, scored once) against F_0
4 protected block once, only if admitted
comparisons: random direction, same columns and strength
same direction as activation steering without a weight change
released third-party edit of the same base
claim_limits: removing non-termination is not the same as forecasting better; a model that never answers scores the last-value fallback, so finishing can raise pinball loss
no recursive-self-improvement claim: the editor is an external LLM
greedy decoding and a 1,024-token cap differ from the released checkpoint's evaluation (sampling, 32,768 tokens)

amendments.written: after passes 10-13 (first edit: 60/60 still hit the limit at strengths 1, 2, 4), before the recursive rounds
amendments.change: exploratory stacking: because termination stayed at zero, rounds may stack an edit using a softer signal on the choose sample (largest drop in duplicate-line share, provided distinct lines do not fall by more than 20%). Each round re-reads the looping direction on the current model's own outputs and edits the two MLPs that write it most.
amendments.unchanged: the keep rule for any claim: termination gain on the confirm split, paired, above twice its standard error
amendments.stop: 6 further rounds, or 10% of choose items terminating, or no strength lowering the duplicate share
